```{r, include = FALSE}
### Load packages
require(tidyverse)
require(leaflet)
require(crosstalk)
library(plotly)
# Idea from https://www.zajichekstats.com/post/filterable-maps/ 
```


```{r data-download, include = FALSE}
# Load Data
HAT_sites_HAT <- read.csv("data/HAT-Sites-HAT.csv", fileEncoding="UTF-8")
str(HAT_sites_HAT)
head(HAT_sites_HAT)

crew_data_sep_sub_sum_by_group_site_1 <- read.csv("data/crew_data_sep_sub_sum_by_group_site.csv", fileEncoding="UTF-8")
str(crew_data_sep_sub_sum_by_group_site_1)
head(crew_data_sep_sub_sum_by_group_site_1)

cover_data <- read.csv("data/HAT_cover_mean.csv", fileEncoding="UTF-8")

```


```{r rename-site-location-worksite-columns-for-sd-key, include = FALSE}

# df_renamed <- df %>%
#  rename(new_colname_A = old_colname_1)

crew_data_sep_sub_sum_by_group_site_rename_site <- crew_data_sep_sub_sum_by_group_site_1 %>%
  rename(Site = Work_Site)

cover_data_rename_site <- cover_data %>%
  rename(Site = Location)

colnames(cover_data_rename_site)
cover_data_rename_site_sub <- subset(cover_data_rename_site, select = -c(9,10,11))
 

```



```{r create-sharable-database, include = FALSE}
### Create sharable database using Crosstalk package
# Make the shared data set
sd_crew <- SharedData$new(data = crew_data_sep_sub_sum_by_group_site_rename_site)
sd_cover <- SharedData$new(data = cover_data_rename_site_sub)
```


```{r create-sharable-database-HAT-sites, include = FALSE}
### Create sharable database using Crosstalk package
# Make the shared data set
sd_sites <- SharedData$new(data = HAT_sites_HAT)
```



# Plots: Crew Data

```{r filter-input-crew-data, echo = FALSE}
bscols(
  widths = 12,
    # widths = c(1,11),
    # "",
    htmltools::em("Note: These filters need to be manually reset to delete unwanted choices")
)

# Create a filter input
site_filter = filter_select(id = "Site", label = "Choose Work Site", sharedData = sd_crew, group = ~ Site, multiple = T)
year_filter = filter_checkbox(id = "Year", label = "Choose Year", sharedData = sd_crew, group = ~ Year, allLevels = TRUE)
# filter_checkbox()
bscols(
  site_filter, 
  widths = 12
)
bscols(
  year_filter, 
  widths = 12
)


```


```{r staff-hrs-site, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
bscols(
  widths = c(1, 11),
  "",
  htmltools::h3("HAT Managed Work Crew Staff Hours Invasive Species Removal", style = "font-style:italic;")
)

## NOTE
# ggplot needs to be wrapped in ggplotly for crosstalk to work
ggplotly(
  ggplot(sd_crew, 
   aes(x = Site, y = Crew_Hours, fill = Site)) + 
#  aes(x = Site, y = Hours)) +   
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.5, position = position_dodge2(padding = 0.2)) +
  theme_minimal() + #get rid of grey background and tick marks
    theme(legend.position ="right") + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust=1, size = 7)) +
    # scale_fill_manual(values = custom_colours_4) +
        labs(
#           title='HAT Staff Site Hours',
#           subtitle='invasive species removal',
#           caption = "Chart by Wendy Anthony \n 2025-11-17", fill = "",          
# #         caption = "Chart by Wendy Anthony \n 2025-11-17", fill = "",
          x = "Site", y = "Staff Hours") +
  geom_text(aes(label = Year), vjust = 1.3, size = 2.5, angle = 45) , 
    tooltip = c("x", "y", "Year"), config = (displayModeBar = False) 
  ) %>%
    layout(legend = list(orientation="h",
    xanchor="center",
    x = 0.5,
    # gives some space between x axis label and legend
    y = -0.2
    ))



# ggsave(filename = paste0("images/HAT_data_inv_site_metrics_staffhrs_plot_", format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d_%H.%M"),".png"), HAT_data_inv_site_metrics_staffhrs)
```

```{r crew-data-2022-2025-plots-biomass-facet, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}

  widths = c(1, 11),
```

# Plots: Cover Data

```{r filter-input-cover-data, echo = FALSE}
bscols(

bscols(

  site_filter, 
  species_filter
)
```

```{r species-richness-treat, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}

# library(ggplot2)
# library(magrittr) # required for %>%
# library(plotly)

# https://ourcodingclub.github.io/tutorials/data-vis-2/
# create custom colour-blind-friendly palette
custom_colours_3 <- c("Invasive" = "#fc8d62", 
                    "Native" = "#66c2a5", 
                    "MixedGrass" = "#8da0cb")
# custom_colours_3 <- c("Native" = "#1b9e77", 
#                     "Invasive" = "#d95f02",
#                     "MixedGrass" = "#7570b3")

ggplotly(
  ggplot(sd_cover, aes(x = mean_value, y = Species, fill = Native_or_Invasive, text = paste("Year:", Year,
                                                          "\nSite:", Site,
                                                          "\nSpecies:", Species,      
                                                          "\nNative or Invasive:", Native_or_Invasive,  
                                                          "\nMean Value:", mean_value,
                                                          "\nSD Value:", sd_value))) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.5, position = "dodge") +
  theme_minimal() + #get rid of grey background and tick marks
  theme(legend.position ="bottom") + 
      labs(
    x = "Mean percent cover",   # Set the x-axis name
    y = "Species",   # Set the y-axis name
    fill = "Native or Invasive", 
    title = "Species Cover at HAT's Oak Haven & Matson 2024-2025"  # Optionally, add a title
  ) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, vjust = 1, hjust=1, size = 7)), 
    # tooltip = c("x", "fill", "Species", "Site", "sd_value"), 
    tooltip = "text",
  config = (displayModeBar = False) 
  ) %>%
    layout(legend = list(orientation = "h",
    xanchor="center",
    x = 0.5,
    # gives some space between x axis label and legend
    y = -0.2
    ))



# ggsave(filename = paste0("images/oakhaven_2025_sp_rich_treat_plot_", format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d_%H.%M"),".png"), oakhaven_2025_sp_rich_treat_plot)
```

# Map

```{r leaflet-all-sites, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, include = FALSE}

# Title control
# (Shackelford, et al., 2024). Global Restore Project. Restoration Futures Lab at the University of Victoria
     title <- '<p style="text-align: center; height: 18px; "><img src="https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5e3c5b7e5460c55405a6d4d6/a8c2fb30-96fd-4042-925f-e76c7040dce6/Black+Logo+2.png?format=5w"><span style="font-size:9px;font-weight:bold; background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9;");>GOE Monitoring Covenant Sites Map</span></p>'
     
    # https://rstudio.github.io/leaflet/articles/markers.html
    # Create a palette that maps factor levels to colors
    #####
 # #d95f02 orange; #7570b3 purple; #1b9e77 
     # https://colorbrewer2.org/#type=qualitative&scheme=Dark2&n=5
    # pal <- colorFactor(c("#1b9e77", "#7570b3", "#d95f02", "#e7298a", "#66a61e"), domain = c("Central Saanich", "Colwood", "Esquimalt", "Saanich", "Metchosin"))
     pal <- colorFactor(c("#1b9e77", "#7570b3", "#e7298a"), domain = c("Central Saanich", "Esquimalt", "Colwood"))
HAT_sites_HAT_map  <-  leaflet(sd_sites) %>%
      addProviderTiles("Esri.WorldImagery") %>%
      addCircleMarkers(
        ~ Lng, ~ Lat,
        #
        color = ~pal(Municipality),
        # color = "yellow",
        weight = 1, # size of circle border
        stroke = TRUE, fillOpacity = 1, #fillOpacity = 0.5
        radius = 5,
        # OM_site_data$
        # "<b>Global Restore Project GOE Monitoring Sites</b>", "<br>", "<i>(Shackelford, et. al., 2005-2022)</i>", "<br><br>",
        popup = paste0(
        "<img src = 'https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5e3c5b7e5460c55405a6d4d6/a8c2fb30-96fd-4042-925f-e76c7040dce6/Black+Logo+2.png?format=5w'>",  "<br>","<br>",
          "<b>Site:</b> ", "<b>", HAT_sites_HAT$Site, "</b>",  "<br>",
          "<b>Municipality:</b> ", HAT_sites_HAT$Municipality, "<br>",
          "<b>Size:</b> ", HAT_sites_HAT$Size_ha, " (ha)", "<br>",
          "<b>First Nations:</b> ", HAT_sites_HAT$FirstNations, "<br>",
          # "<b>Project id:</b> ", HAT_sites_HAT$ID, "<br>",
          "<b>HAT Status:</b> ", HAT_sites_HAT$HAT_Status, "<br>",
          "<b>Co-Covenant:</b> ", HAT_sites_HAT$Co_Covenant, " (", HAT_sites_HAT$Date, ")", "<br>",
          "<b>Ecosystems:</b> ", HAT_sites_HAT$Ecosystems, "<br>",
          "<b>Volunteer Stewardship:</b> ", HAT_sites_HAT$Volunteer_Stewardship, "<br>"
          ))  %>%
      addLegend("bottomright", pal = pal, values = HAT_sites_HAT$Municipality, title = "Municipality") %>%

      setView(-123.44799, 48.52919, 9) %>%
      # add controls
      #  addMiniMap(width = 150, height = 150, zoomLevelOffset = -4) %>%
      addControl(title, position = "topright")

# Display map
HAT_sites_HAT_map

# Save map
# saveWidget(HAT_sites_HAT_map, "output/HAT_site_HAT_map.html")
```


```{r map-filter, echo = FALSE}
# order of elements to appear on webpage
bscols(
  widths = c(1, 11),
  "",
  htmltools::h3("HAT Managed Public GOE Sites", style = "font-style:italic;")
)
# Size filter
bscols(
  widths = c(1, 10, 1),
  "",
  filter_slider(
    id = "Size_ha",
    label = "Size in ha",
    sharedData = sd_sites,
    column = ~Size_ha,
    step = 1,
    min = 0,
    max = 20,
    post = "ha"
  ),
  ""
)

bscols(
    widths = c(1,11),
    "",
    htmltools::h4("Note: These filters need to be manually reset to ALL")
)
# Cohort filters: Row 1
bscols(
  widths = c(1, 3, 3, 3, 1),
  "",
  filter_select(
    id = "Partner_Code",
    label = "Partner",
    sharedData = sd_sites,
    group = ~Partner_Code
  ),
  filter_select(
    id = "Municipality",
    label = "Municipality",
    sharedData = sd_sites,
    group = ~Municipality
  ),
  filter_select(
    id = "FirstNations",
    label = "First Nations",
    sharedData = sd_sites,
    group = ~FirstNations
  ),
  ""
)
HAT_sites_HAT_map
```
